source: Doolally Taproom, Chembur: floor plan v1 (two digital plans and two hand sketches supplied by the user, 24 Nov 2026; pixel coordinates, proportions only). Replaces the Khar rough plan. Not visited.

metresPerPx.note: The plan has no scale. 0.0068 m per px makes a 2-seat table with chairs 1.4 m long. Every dimension in the scene follows from this.

stepCount.note: No steps are drawn on the Chembur plans. Insufficient evidence either way; the floor is modelled level.

stepRiseM.note: Unused while the step count is 0.

proposed.label: Proposed waitlist kiosk
proposed.note: Does not exist today. A design proposal for a token kiosk just inside the main-road door. ASSUMED LAYOUT: no plan fixes where it would stand.

proposed.label: Proposed wait lounge
proposed.note: Does not exist today. A design proposal for the bottom-left corner of the outdoor seating. Serving here needs Excise confirmation (register R8).

proposed.label: Proposed takeaway counter
proposed.note: Does not exist today. A design proposal beside the main-road door. Takeaway sales need separate licensing (register R8).

zones.label: Entrance from main road
zones.note: Door "Entry from main road" at the street edge of the outdoor seating (floor plan v1, user-drawn, not visited).
zones.assumed: Door width, host stand position, wall heights.
zones.openQuestion: Door width and where the host stands.

zones.label: Pavement queue (public space)
zones.note: Where a queue would form outside the main-road door. No source says where it forms.
zones.assumed: Pavement depth and where the line forms.
zones.openQuestion: Where does the line form on a busy night?

zones.label: Outdoor seating
zones.note: Outdoor plan of floor plan v1: 13 tables, 50 seats. Table positions are schematic (the plan has no scale).
zones.openQuestion: Real outdoor dimensions, covering and table sizes.

zones.label: Passage between outdoor and indoor
zones.note: The plan shows an "Entry for indoor seating" door on the outdoor plan and an "Entry from outdoor seating" door on the indoor plan. How they link is not drawn; modelled as a short straight passage at floor level.
zones.assumed: Where and how the two doors connect; no steps are shown.
zones.openQuestion: How do guests get from the outdoor seating to the indoor door?

zones.label: Indoor seating
zones.note: Indoor plan of floor plan v1: 10 tables, 31 seats. Table positions are schematic (the plan has no scale).
zones.openQuestion: Real indoor dimensions, pillars and table sizes.

zones.label: Bar
zones.note: Bar along the top of the indoor plan. No bar stools are drawn, so none are counted as seats.
zones.openQuestion: Are there bar stools, and do walk-ins use them?

zones.label: Kitchen entry
zones.note: Kitchen entry at the lower right of the indoor plan; the interior is not modelled.

zones.label: Bathroom entrance
zones.note: Bathroom entrance along the right wall of the indoor plan; the interior is not modelled.
